verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's core value prop is writing background workflows in plain async TypeScript rather than YAML/DSL, with durable execution features like automatic retries, waitpoints/pause-resume, and version locking that constitute checkpointing; this is corroborated by hands-on community reports of migrating from GUI-based tools (n8n) to code-first authoring with major productivity gains. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement using the term 'automatic checkpointing,' and one community comment (trigger-dev-comm-6) notes friction with file-system-based task conventions, showing the code model isn't fully unopinionated.
